root_cause.explanation: Coverage ended 2025-05-31 per 271 (EB*6, DTP*357). DOS 2025-06-12 falls after termination. Payer correctly denied PR-27 with N30.

next_action.detail: Issue patient statement for $181.22. Coverage verified inactive on DOS; no other payer identified. Collect from patient.
